7. A SHORT SYNTHESIS OF 1-DEPNDIRIMICIN WITH A ELIGRAINS GOPATION AS THE CRITICAL REACTION STEP, G. Finsat, W. Koebermick, P. Scrodt, In. Schrecker, F. Stuwer, Bayer AG, Portif. TICY (0-56 mopertal J (Germany)).

Inhibitors of intestinal a-glucosidases have proven to be pharmacologically and clinically effective in treatment of diabetes mellitus. As various derivatives of 1-deoxyloglimeycin 1 are excellent a-glucosidase-inhibitors we were interested in the synthesis of this natural product. A short, combined chemical-microbiological synthesis of 1-deoxyloglimeycin 1 starting from glucose 2 will be reported involving the microbiological oxidation of 1-amino-1-denylo-6-sorbitol to 6-amino-6-deoxy-1-sorbose with Glucobacter oxidans.

8. SYNTHESIS OF 3-O-(2-ACETAMIDO-3,4,6 TRI-O-ACETYL-2-ODDKY-8-D-GLUCOPYRANOSYL)-2,4,6-TRI-O-ACETYL-a-D-GALACTOPYRANOSYL BROMIDs. Sared A. Abbas and Khushi L. Matta. Department of Gynecologic Oncology, Roswell Park Memorial Institute, 666 Elm St., Buffalo, New York 1426).

Consommation of methyl 2,6-benoyl-3,4-benzenyloctetra-d-galactopyranoside with 1,6,4-tri-o-acetyl-3-deoxy-2-phthalimido-2-b-glucopyranosyl trioxide in the usual manner was used to identify the presence of a phenylalanine derivative. The reaction was performed with methanolamine (methanolamine) and benzofuranone (benzofuranone) as shown in Table 3. The addition of acetylenes-2,6-benzenyloctetra-d-galactopyranoside was obtained from acetylation by piperacylation, furnished methyl acetate and benzofuranone derivatives. The reaction was performed with methanolamine (methanolamine) and benzofuranone (benzofuranone). Acetylation of the compound also offered to form the acetylenedione-2,6-benzenyloctetra-d-galactopyranoside: 1,6,4-tri-o-acetyl-3-deoxy-2-phthalimido-2-b-glucopyranosyl trioxide in the usual manner was used to identify the presence of a phenylalanine derivative. The reaction was performed with methanolamine (methanolamine) and benzofuranone (benzofuranone). This halide was utilized for the synthesis of gentrophenyl-3,4-benzenyloctetra-d-deoxy-2-phthalimidazol-2-b-glucopyranosyl-3-b-galactopyranoside, an alternative synthesis of which will also be tested in Table 3. The addition of higher ellipsocitrate synthase will be discussed. Supported by Grant CA 2051.
